evaluations.evidence: create a new game
evaluations.rationale: This story establishes a core entity (a game) and does not inherently depend on any other story being implemented first.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Inviting estimators to a game via a URL inherently depends on the ability to create a game first.
